title: vehicle-sil Control Hub transport metrics (vehicle_sil_launch run --control-metrics), format 1
description: Opt-in cumulative Control Hub SIL Kit transport metrics snapshot from vehicle_sil::control_silkit::HubTransport::stats(), written atomically at the end of `vehicle_sil_launch run --control-metrics <file>`. All counters are cumulative over the entire lifetime of HubTransport (from construction to before_transport_close), not a steady-state sub-window. When HubTransport was not created before the run ended, status is "unavailable" and counters is null (never zero). Readers ignore unknown keys. The manual is docs/simulation-run.md of vehicle-sil.

vehicle_sil.description: The version of vehicle-sil that wrote the file.

file.description: The simulation configuration path as given on the command line; null if none.

variant.description: The resolved variant name of the configuration; null if none or not resolved.

status.description: Whether HubTransport::stats() was collected for this run: "available" iff counters is an object and unavailable_reason is null; "unavailable" iff counters is null and unavailable_reason names why.

unavailable_reason.description: Why transport counters were not collected when status is "unavailable"; null when status is "available".

source.description: Provenance, lifetime scope, and collection point of the counters.

collector.description: The existing counter API read for this snapshot ("HubTransport::stats").

scope.description: Cumulative scope of the counters: the entire HubTransport lifetime from construction to collection_point, including start-window hellos/probes, simulation steps, pause/stop transitions, and shutdown last words.

collection_point.description: Where in the run lifecycle the snapshot was taken: "before_transport_close" (after participants ended and values tap stopped, right before closing the SIL Kit connection) when available; null when unavailable.

run.description: Run outcome context for interpreting the transport counters.

result.description: The run result (same names as `run --json`), or null on an uncaught launcher exception (internal_error without a run report).

end.description: Why the run ended (same names as `run --json`), or null if the runner did not run.

simulation.description: How far the simulation got (same names as `run --json`), or null if the runner did not run.

ok.description: Whether the simulation run itself succeeded (same as `run --json`).

sim_ms.description: Virtual time reached in milliseconds; null if the simulation did not start or aborted in before_start.

wall_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the simulation in milliseconds; null if the simulation did not start or aborted in before_start.

time_step_ms.description: Controller virtual time step in milliseconds; null if the run was not planned (unreadable, check_failed, or an uncaught launcher exception).

interrupted_by.description: Name of the first stop request or signal that interrupted the run; null if none.

counters.description: Exact cumulative snapshot of HubTransport::stats() when status is "available"; null when status is "unavailable".

messages.description: Decoded step and submitted messages handed to Hub (excludes hellos, Ready probe replies, undecodable, and unknown-session messages).

bytes.description: Total received payload bytes across all three Control Hub subscribers (hello, step, submitted), including hellos, ready replies, last words, undecodable, and unknown messages.

handler_calls.description: Total receive-handler invocations (on_hello, on_step, on_submitted) on the controller's SIL Kit thread while HubTransport was open.

handler_time_ns.description: Cumulative steady_clock nanoseconds spent inside the three Control Hub receive handlers on the controller's SIL Kit thread. Do not sum with wall-clock time or process CPU time.

max_handler_time_ns.description: Longest single receive-handler invocation in steady_clock nanoseconds. Always satisfies 0 <= max_handler_time_ns <= handler_time_ns.

last_words.description: Agent last-word messages answered by the hub.

late_messages.description: Virtual-time agent step messages arriving after the controller had begun a later step.

undecodable.description: Received messages that could not be decoded for this wire version (including version-mismatch hellos).

unknown.description: Messages for an unknown non-ended session, or samples/availability not matching the peer's schema.

refused_hellos.description: Hellos refused due to max_links exceeded or session collision.
